title: Minutes of low mean arterial pressure during neonatal anaesthetics, and deaths within 90 days

statement.cohort: Every anaesthetic of a neonate, a child under 28 days old by calendar date on the day the anaesthetic started, leaving out test patients, anaesthetics with no start and anaesthetics whose stop is before their start.
statement.outcome: The minutes of the anaesthetic for which the mean arterial pressure, from the cuff or from an arterial line, stood below 40, and whether the child died within 90 days of the anaesthetic.
statement.result: One row for each band of minutes below 40, with the number of anaesthetics in the band, the number after which the child died within 90 days, the number of children, and the number of those children who died within 90 days of one of those anaesthetics.

decisions.choice: age in days at the start, by calendar date, below 28
decisions.decision: A neonate is a child whose age in days at the start of the anaesthetic, counted by calendar date from the date of birth, is below 28.

decisions.choice: test patients, no start, stop before start
decisions.decision: A test patient is left out, as is an anaesthetic with no start or with a stop before its start.

decisions.choice: cuff and arterial means, accepted, with a value
decisions.decision: The question reads the mean from the cuff and the mean from an arterial line, accepted and with a value, and no mean calculated from a charted systolic and diastolic pressure.

decisions.about: when a reading belongs to the anaesthetic
decisions.choice: from the start to the stop, open where there is no stop
decisions.decision: A reading belongs to the anaesthetic when it was taken from the start to the stop; where the anaesthetic has no recorded stop, the window stays open after the start.

decisions.about: two readings at the same time
decisions.choice: arterial over cuff, then the lower value
decisions.decision: Where a cuff mean and an arterial mean have the same time, the arterial one is kept; where two readings of the same kind have the same time, the lower value is kept.

decisions.choice: until the next reading or the stop, and five minutes at most
decisions.decision: Each kept reading stands until the next kept reading of the same anaesthetic, or until the stop for the last reading, and for no longer than five minutes; the last reading of an anaesthetic with no recorded stop stands for no time.
The minutes below 40 are the sum of the time for which the readings below 40 stand.

decisions.choice: from the date of the start to 90 days after, both days included
decisions.decision: The child died within 90 days when the date of death lies from the date of the start of the anaesthetic to 90 days after that date, both days included.

decisions.choice: no reading, none, under 5, 5 to 14, 15 or more
decisions.decision: The result gives one row for each band of minutes below 40, in order: no mean pressure recorded, none, under 5 minutes, 5 to 14 minutes, and 15 minutes or more.

examinable.because: The result counts anaesthetics and children in bands of one measure and the deaths after each, which the oracle's vocabulary has no words for; the question's held-out answer is the planted neonates' in the role model.

question_sql:
-- Among neonates who had an anaesthetic, how many minutes of the anaesthetic did each spend with a mean arterial pressure
-- below 40, and how many of the children died within 90 days of the anaesthetic?
-- The query reads only the three role views, role_patient, role_anaesthetic and role_reading, so that it runs unchanged
-- at any hospital whose map supplies them. Its rules are those of fixtures/targets/neonatal_low_mean_pressure.sql, so
-- that the two answers can be compared.
-- A neonate is a child whose age in days at the start of the anaesthetic, counted by calendar date from the date of
-- birth, is below 28. A test patient is left out, as is an anaesthetic with no start or with a stop before its start.
-- The query reads the mean from the cuff (map_cuff) and the mean from an arterial line (map_arterial), accepted and
-- with a value, and no mean that was calculated from a charted systolic and diastolic pressure.
-- A reading belongs to the anaesthetic when it was taken from the start to the stop. Where the anaesthetic has no
-- recorded stop, the window stays open after the start.
-- Where a cuff mean and an arterial mean of the same anaesthetic have the same time, the query keeps the arterial one.
-- Where two readings of the same kind have the same time, it keeps the lower value, because the role views carry no
-- order of entry; the OMOP query keeps the one with the lower measurement_id instead.
-- Each kept reading stands until the next kept reading of the same anaesthetic, or until the stop for the last
-- reading, and for no longer than five minutes. The last reading of an anaesthetic with no recorded stop stands for no
-- time, because nothing marks when it stopped applying.
-- The minutes below 40 are the sum of the time for which the readings below 40 stand.
-- The child died within 90 days when the date of death lies from the date of the start of the anaesthetic to 90 days
-- after that date, both days included.
-- The query counts anaesthetics, so that a child with two neonatal anaesthetics is counted once for each of them, and
-- it also counts children, so that a child is counted once in each band in which one of their anaesthetics falls.
-- It gives one row for each band of minutes below 40, in order: no mean pressure recorded, none, under 5 minutes,
-- 5 to 14 minutes, and 15 minutes or more, with the number of anaesthetics in the band, the number of those after
-- which the child died within 90 days, the number of children, and the number of those children who died within 90
-- days of one of those anaesthetics.
WITH neonatal AS (
    SELECT a.anaesthetic_key,
           a.patient_key,
           a.start_time,
           a.stop_time,
           CASE WHEN p.death_date >= CAST(a.start_time AS date)
                 AND p.death_date <= DATEADD(day, 90, CAST(a.start_time AS date)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS died
    FROM   role_anaesthetic a
           JOIN role_patient p ON p.patient_key = a.patient_key
    WHERE  p.is_test = 0
      AND  a.start_time IS NOT NULL
      AND  (a.stop_time IS NULL OR a.stop_time >= a.start_time)
      AND  DATEDIFF(day, p.birth_date, a.start_time) < 28
),
reading AS (
    SELECT n.anaesthetic_key,
           n.stop_time,
           r.reading_time,
           r.value,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.anaesthetic_key, r.reading_time
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.kind = 'map_arterial' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.value) AS kept_at_time
    FROM   neonatal n
           JOIN role_reading r
             ON r.anaesthetic_key = n.anaesthetic_key
            AND r.kind IN ('map_arterial', 'map_cuff')
            AND r.accepted = 1
            AND r.value IS NOT NULL
            AND r.reading_time >= n.start_time
            AND (n.stop_time IS NULL OR r.reading_time <= n.stop_time)
),
stood AS (
    SELECT anaesthetic_key,
           value,
           reading_time,
           COALESCE(LEAD(reading_time) OVER (PARTITION BY anaesthetic_key ORDER BY reading_time), stop_time) AS until_time
    FROM   reading
    WHERE  kept_at_time = 1
),
low AS (
    SELECT anaesthetic_key,
           SUM(CASE WHEN value < 40 AND until_time IS NOT NULL
                    THEN CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(second, reading_time, until_time) > 300 THEN 300
                              ELSE DATEDIFF(second, reading_time, until_time) END
                    ELSE 0 END) / 60.0 AS minutes_below_40
    FROM   stood
    GROUP  BY anaesthetic_key
),
banded AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN l.anaesthetic_key IS NULL THEN 0
                WHEN l.minutes_below_40 = 0 THEN 1
                WHEN l.minutes_below_40 < 5 THEN 2
                WHEN l.minutes_below_40 < 15 THEN 3
                ELSE 4 END AS band,
           n.anaesthetic_key,
           n.patient_key,
           YEAR(n.start_time) AS start_year,
           l.minutes_below_40,
           n.died
    FROM   neonatal n
           LEFT JOIN low l ON l.anaesthetic_key = n.anaesthetic_key
),
band AS (
    SELECT 0 AS band, 'no mean pressure recorded' AS minutes_below_40
    UNION ALL SELECT 1, 'none'
    UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'under 5 minutes'
    UNION ALL SELECT 3, '5 to 14 minutes'
    UNION ALL SELECT 4, '15 minutes or more'
)
SELECT b.minutes_below_40,
       COUNT(x.band) AS anaesthetics,
       COALESCE(SUM(x.died), 0) AS died_within_90_days,
       COUNT(DISTINCT x.patient_key) AS children,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN x.died = 1 THEN x.patient_key END) AS children_died_within_90_days
FROM   band b
       LEFT JOIN banded x ON x.band = b.band
GROUP  BY b.band, b.minutes_below_40
ORDER  BY b.band
note: The question is the neonatal audit that ships with the role model, written as a package by hand so that the reader has one package it accepts.
